resolved_base_copy.headline: Plan the week in one calm board.
resolved_base_copy.support_line: A focused planning space for small product teams.

resolved_message_package.note: This package is required as the activation parent, but its audience, offer, release, proof, CTA, destination and qualifier are superseded by the final activation.

logo.visual_signature: Separate horizontal FlowForge signature with amber-and-sage folded-path symbol and dark-green wordmark

hero.visual_signature: Launch-week board with LAUNCH WEEK pill, highlighted THU lane, and featured Ship release card

background.visual_signature: Warm cream fine-grid field with sage upper-right diagonal band, amber stepped lower-right corner, and dark-teal left rail

proof_chip.visual_signature: Amber chip with dark-green check and text Built for cross-functional launch weeks

selection_logic.activation: Select the unique activation matching MSG-063, SPRINT-JUNE-2026, PRF-044, GLOBAL-EN, LINKEDIN-SPONSORED-SINGLE and en-GB whose latest status at or before freeze is Active and whose effective window includes launch day.
selection_logic.catalogs: All referenced catalog records must be Approved for the required market/language and valid on launch day.
selection_logic.experiment: EXP-064 must match the same campaign/profile/market/placement and be Approved on launch day; it controls BND-094 and BDC-088.
selection_logic.assets: Each bundle asset must independently satisfy latest pre-freeze approval, exact usage scope, paid-social rights, Released state before freeze, and no withdrawal before launch.
